title: HealthExclusions
description: data/running/owner/health-exclusions.yaml: readings to drop as erroneous (FR-067), one day or, with onwards, every day from date on, removed before any average is computed. List files carry no schema_version; they are always the current version.

onwards.description: true: also drop every later reading of this metric, for a source that needs recalibrating. The pause ends when the entry is removed.
